1 Asset Optimization Community Lead (m/f/x) Join us and drive the energy revolution

We are looking for an Asset Optimization Community Lead (m/f/x) who wants to play a key role in shaping and scaling our asset optimization capabilities within a fast-growing energy trading environment. Reporting directly to our CTO, you will lead our 2 Asset Optimization Teams (4 people each), ensuring optimization work is scoped, prioritized, planned, and delivered effectively in line with customer, commercial, product, and delivery demands.

Note: We can only consider candidates based in Austria, Belgium, Slovakia, Spain, and the UK (or open to relocation to one of these countries, provided the candidate holds the right to work).

Redefine "automation" in energy trading

As part of our team of experts, you will

 * Lead and develop the Asset Optimization Teams, ensuring strong performance, well-being, and continuous growth

 * Own prioritization and planning of optimization work

 * Balance delivery commitments with reactive commercial and customer demands

 * Act as the key coordination point between optimization and the wider business

 * Communicate priorities, trade-offs, and expectations clearly to stakeholders

 * Support customer-facing discussions and commercial opportunities with optimization expertise

 * Ensure short-notice and high-priority requests are handled in a structured and controlled way

 * Represent the optimization function across the organization

 * Continuously improve the scalability, effectiveness, and operational maturity of the team

Job requirements
You want to participate in the transition to clean energy actively, and you

 * Value strong team spirit, ownership, and a pragmatic, solution-oriented culture

 * Have a strong understanding of asset optimization and energy market dynamics

 * Bring experience in leading and coordinating technical/specialist teams

 * Have worked with commercial, delivery, and technical stakeholders

 * Possess strong prioritization, planning, and workload management skills

 * Communicate clearly and confidently, including in customer-facing settings

 * Are able to translate business and customer needs into clear team priorities

 * Remain calm under pressure and can manage competing demands effectively

 * Balance being supportive with the ability to set boundaries and protect team focus

 * Have a structured, disciplined, and improvement-driven mindset

 * Communicate fluently in English

 * If you also have experience in energy trading, BESS optimization, flexibility markets, or similar domains, it's a plus

 * Have experience in pilots, backtesting, discovery work, or solution shaping is an advantage

 * Have experience in scale-ups or fast-growing environments is beneficial

What's in it for you?

No matter who you are, at enspired, we embrace your authenticity because we know that true innovation comes from the contributions of each team member. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of benefits.

 * 60 days of work from anywhere

 * 30 days of vacation

 * A modern tech stack with the freedom to innovate 

 * Referral bonus

 * Extensive support of lifelong learners

 * Regular social events and holiday parties

 * Free public transportation ticket in Vienna

 * Free lunch & fruits and fair-trade coffee at the office

 * Offsetting your private CO2 emissions

 * Sustainable enspired merch

Along with the listed benefits that are part of the overall compensation package, the salary for this role is aligned with a band starting at EUR 95,000, with the actual salary determined based on the experience and skills brought to the position.

GDPR disclaimer: We are storing the personal data of applicants for the further processing of applications. After the recruiting process ends, the purpose no longer applies. After six months, a deletion request is possible unless the data is needed to guarantee and process claims under employment law.

https://enspired.recruitee.com/o/...

Founded in 2020 to solve the biggest challenges in the energy industry, enspired has been pushing the boundaries of innovation since day one. Driven by the belief that technology will make the energy transition a reality, we developed a state-of-the-art optimization platform in the early days of algo trading to integrate the flexibility we need for an efficient and sustainable energy system.

Today we know that future-proof battery revenues are the backbone of the renewable buildout. As the leader of the transparency movement in BESS revenue assessment, we publish verifiable commercial results to establish a new, reliable benchmarking standard that helps battery owners get a true understanding of what their asset is worth. 1 Senior Sales Expert (f/m/x) Join us and help drive the energy transition

Have you always wanted to be part of a team that makes a difference? As the leading optimizer of Grid Scale Storage across Europe, we do just that! We are expanding our team and looking for a Senior Sales Expert (f/m/x) who wants to play a key role in strengthening our position across Europe. As part of our Growth Team, you will enjoy strong go-to-market support from both marketing and business development.

Note: We can consider candidates based in Austria, Belgium, Slovakia, Spain, and the UK

Ready to make a difference? As part of our handpicked growth team, you will

 * Build relationships with renewable and grid-scale storage developers in your region

 * Take full responsibility for the entire B2B sales cycle

 * Manage opportunities, your pipeline, and close deals

 * Work with your colleagues to provide value at every stage of a client's project

 * Share our vision at every touchpoint - calls/events/initiatives

 * Ultimately, win and retain satisfied customers

Job requirements

How you fit into the team

You want to participate in the transition to clean energy actively, and

 * Bring +5 years of quota-carrying sales experience

 * Have an understanding of the power industry and the role that flexibility plays in the energy transition

 * Have competence in complex and solution-oriented sales methods

 * Are enthusiastic when articulating technical and business value

 * Enjoy developing and executing a comprehensive territory plan

 * Are eager to leverage marketing automation strategies

 * Bring perfect oral and written communication in English as well as in Polish or Italian

 * Have been actively involved in the Polish or Italian markets (nice to have)

 * Like to travel and to drive the sales cycle even on business trips

 * Value excellent team spirit and creative freedom

What's in it for you?

We believe in transparency and keep our colleagues updated on every aspect of our business. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of benefits

 * Hybrid and flexible working model

 * 30 days of vacation

 * 60 days of work from anywhere

 * Referral bonus

 * Extensive support of lifelong learners

 * Regular social events and holiday parties in Austria

 * Free lunch & fruits and fair-trade coffee at the office

 * Offsetting your private CO2 emissions

 * Sustainable enspired merch

 * Very competitive compensation package with uncapped commission

 * Continuous sales and industry training

We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants. We offer an attractive salary which corresponds to your skills of at least EUR 85.000 gross per year.

jobs.description:

From research & development, engineering, production to marketing and sales - we offer everything from a single source under one roof. This will give you exciting insights into other departments of the company. Although we have our roots in Austria, we are "born global" and work with customers and sales partners all over the world.

Making Future Reality together - are you in? 1 Senior Hardware Developer (m/w/d) - The PCB Whisperer Vienna, fulltime

Tasks

What You'll Be Doing

 * Define hardware architecture and identify key components for high-end wearable devices

 * Design and develop schematics and PCB layouts with HDI and EMC-compliant design

 * Contribute to design-for-manufacturing strategy for PCB-integrated systems in wearable glasses

 * Drive hardware bring-up and support test device development

 * Collaborate closely with mechanics, firmware developers, and optics - because our product is all of them at once

Requirements

What You Bring to the Team

 * A completed degree or vocational training (TU/FH/HTL) in electrical engineering, embedded systems, or a related field

 * Hands-on experience in hardware development

 * Strong understanding of PCB manufacturing and assembly processes

 * Proven experience in HDI electronic circuit development and EMC-compliant design

 * Solid background in schematic design and component selection

 * Basic knowledge of firmware and driver programming

 * Fluent English; German is a bonus

Nice to have

 * Proficiency with Altium Designer

 * Experience with high-speed, flex-PCB, or thermal management circuits

 * Experience with camera circuit design

 * Familiarity with certification processes - especially EMC validation

Benefits

What's extra?

 * Salary: €3.954 - €5.500 gross/month depending on experience

 * Yearly public transport card (Vienna)

 * Workation within the EEA

 * Dog-friendly offices

 * "Inspire Days" - time to learn and recharge

 * A front-row seat to how a deep-tech hardware product gets built - from PCB to shipped device

 * Small, international team where your impact is visible every day

Ready to design the circuits that power the future of wearables?

We can't wait to meet you.

Making Future Reality - let's wire it together.

Send us your application and let's take off together!
